reviewer.name: Codex independent Qingshigao 111 fresh canonical Chinese source-date auditor

summary: Fresh independent canonical Chinese source-date audit after curation af55db87dfbf897a8db53e009b50ed32a82b23ed. All 250 Chinese units, 85 temporal or active-hint items, and 37 people were checked. The curated removal of reign-wide and early-reign life intervals is sound, but Ji Zhenyi’s s0031 event is incorrectly labeled 「唐熙元年」 rather than the source’s following 「三年」. Wang Jingqi, Zha Siting, and the Yongzheng Emperor correctly retain source-faithful 「雍正中」 research holds, which preclude approval but require no invented precision. No extraction data was changed by this audit.
